"# Commercial Cleaning Melbourne
### Corporate Office in Melbourne

Corporate [Office](https://www.amcclean.com.au/office-cleaning/) in Melbourne

Melbourne is known for its high-rise buildings and a bustling corporate lifestyle. AMC's corporate [office cleaning services](https://www.amcclean.com.au/office-cleaning/) are designed to keep your workplace clean, professional, and productive. We offer a variety of services for your office like daily surface cleaning your workstations, window cleaning, toilet cleaning, carpet cleaning, floor maintenance, kitchens, meeting rooms and reception areas.
### School Facilities in Melbourne

[School](https://www.amcclean.com.au/school-cleaning/) Facilities in Melbourne

Schools have high foot-fall and are prone to high-risk if not cleaned and disinfected daily. AMC's school cleaning services in Melbourne offer special cleaning packages called Protect+. It is a school cleaning programme designed to include high touchpoint disinfection plus comprehensive cleaning of a school premises. Whether they are large campuses or large classrooms, to laboratories, common rooms, auditoriums, gyms, offices, staff rooms, AMC commercial cleaning's [school cleaning](https://www.amcclean.com.au/school-cleaning/) programme is designed to create a safe and healthy learning environment for students, staff and parents.

With experience in [cleaning aged care and disability care facilities](https://www.amcclean.com.au/aged-care-and-retirement-cleaning/) in Melbourne, we understand the regulations and compliance factors. Our service management is tailored to meet specific needs of the facility managers. Our main focus is on training and discipline of cleaning staff. Their dedication to consistent high standards in all things. We recognise that in aged care facilities, respect and peace of mind are essential for residents, staff, and families even when it comes to cleanliness.

AMC's specialised childcare cleaning programme understands the unique needs of childcare facilities, where cleanliness is paramount to ensure the well-being of children and staff alike. With a focus on using child-safe and [chemical free cleaning products](https://www.amcclean.com.au/why-choose-us/), we go above and beyond to provide hygienically clean play areas, classrooms, restrooms, and common spaces. ### Showroom Cleaning in Melbourne

In the bustling city of Melbourne, where businesses strive to leave a lasting impression on their clients, maintaining a clean showroom is crucial for success. Our team of experienced and dedicated cleaners is well-versed in the intricacies of showroom cleaning, ensuring that every corner of your space is meticulously sanitised and polished.
### Industrial Cleaning in Melbourne

AMC Commercial Cleaning is committed to providing our customers with the highest quality of service. We are a fully insured and licensed company, and we compliance and commit to safety. Our Melbourne team is experienced and qualified to deliver services using specialised equipment and techniques to clean a wide range of industrial, logistics or warehouse surfaces, including floors, walls, ceilings, and machinery. We provide a variety of special cleaning services, such as high-pressure cleaning, waste removal and floor maintenance.
### Offering a Range of Customised Cleaning Services for your Business

Melbourne is a commercial hub with busy workplaces, large building and organisations. Understanding that commercial cleaning is at high demand in Melbourne, so is our standards in delivering cleaning services according to specific needs of our customers. ### Trained and Professional Commercial Cleaning Staff in Melbourne

We have a large pool of cleaning staff who are carefully selected, security checked, reference checked and put through the AMC training and induction. The training programme covers mandatory Work, Health and Safety training and certification, general cleaning, use of cleaning tools, use of equipment, cleaning of various types of surfaces as well as use of technology for daily reporting and issue resolution.
### Supervision and Management of Service Operation

We believe that it is our genuine commitment to quality management through rigorous supervision and service management that have led to our success in Melbourne. Our service operations structure ensures, be it a cleaning service person or a customer service manager, our people understand their roles and responsibilities across a multi-layered service structure that mitigates risk, ensures quality and always provides peace of mind.
### Quality Assurance and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

We're committed to transparency and accountability. Our Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) help us measure and track our performance against set benchmarks. This ensures that we consistently deliver the highest quality cleaning services to our clients.
### Consistent Monitoring and Reporting in Real Time

We conduct regular checks and quality audits which are reported in real time via a customer portal to maintain consistent high cleaning standards. We adhere to agreed-upon service levels for onsite satisfaction, responsiveness, account management, risk control and issue resolution.
